create_observation: create an Observation namedtuple with board and layers properties for pycolab game rendering
build_base_observation_renderer: build a BaseObservationRenderer canvas to render pycolab game observations with clear, paint, and render methods
build_unoccluded_observation_renderer: build a BaseUnoccludedObservationRenderer that preserves all layer information without z-order occlusion
repaint_observation_characters: repaint an Observation's characters using a character mapping dict via ObservationCharacterRepainter
convert_observation_to_array: convert an Observation to a 2-D or 3-D numpy array with custom value mapping and optional dimension permutation
